# mobius 0.16.48

Retries transient model transport failures within the configured retry budget, improves rejected patch diagnostics, and applies the shared repetition policy to observable provider-hosted tools. Progress updates remain bounded and survive model steps and compaction; interrupted native work is never replayed.

Refreshes built-in Kimi and image model defaults and compatible runtime dependencies. Existing saved image 2.5 routes using built-in catalogs must be reselected before startup. Codex image 2.6 acceptance has not been live-verified.

Protocol 97 and stored record formats are unchanged.
